title: The Halal market
subtitle: Facts and figures
message: Halal products currently account for {{20%}} of global food production.

stats.title: {{Global}} data
paragraphs:
With a global customer base
of 1.8 billion Muslims, Halal is today
one of the fastest-growing global markets.

At the same time, with annual growth of around 1.84%,
Muslims are the fastest-growing population group.

It is also an emerging market force
that attracts non-Muslims with its healthy,
hygienic and contamination-free
principles of food production.

The volume of Halal products is estimated at around
USD 2.1–2.3 trillion.

Of this, approx. USD 675–700 billion
is accounted for by the food sector.

stats.title: {{European}} data
paragraphs: In Europe, the Halal market is estimated at EUR 70 billion.

In France alone, the sector is worth EUR 7.5 billion,
exceeding even sales of organic products.

In Germany, the volume is around EUR 5 billion,
with a large share accounted for by meat and fish products.

columns.text: WHU has set itself the goal of meeting the individual needs of every client in the Halal certification process. In Halal certification, WHU focuses on food and cosmetics, and also offers consulting and training. Halal certification has many benefits which, in the production of food and cosmetics, lead to respectful interaction between people, animals and nature. Production is sustainable and economically responsible.
